criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bespoke frames each made for their sentence and unlike their neighbours; frame 4 magazine grade; frame 2 count reads; frame 8 encoding reads. Held down by frame 6 (two small slips in a thin band of sand under haze), the cover (mannequin dollhouse, thin glass focal, a four line dek on a wash), frame 7 (trays read as ending at the bench edge), frame 9 (laptop stack floating), frame 4 (a lit cyan rocker end can read as on).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The spine holds; the three question tabs on 5 to 7 and the seam motif work; frame 8 steps outside the palette with a peach violet sweep; the accent wobbles on 4 and on 6's pen.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every slide string traces to a claim; AMA figures attributed to the release on S8 and in the caption; Forty is FIG.half; no implied result. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and what is measured land by frame 4; Austin and Travis County never named; nothing actionable, no results date; the stake stated generally.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Half of them get Claude earns a swipe; the turn at 5 is clear; frames 1, 2 and 4 restate the split; S4 repeats S1's dek; the close is soft.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; drawn to illustrate repeated on nine deks reads as the machine covering itself; deks run long; little Texas texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A fresh concept and a medium change on most frames; explainer tone and sweep recur; the cover opens on a headline over a raked 3D model.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the cover as one bold close crop of the split itself, two matched cart screens across a real glass wall filling half the frame, a two line dek, and cut the repeated drawn to illustrate tails.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Two small slips in a thin strip of sand between haze and footer; pen reads cyan blue.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low rake and push in so the slips span 80 percent of the width; recolour the pen indigo.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Thin glass focal, mannequin figures at dollhouse scale, a four line dek on a wash.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop in on the two cart screens across a modelled glass pane, rooms bleeding off the edges, two line dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Trays read as ending at the bench edge; pills loose on the bench.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Run each track to a cyan pan at the laptop's side and seat each pill against its tray.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The lit cyan rocker end reads as on at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Make the proud end a dead matte cyan or move the cyan to a small unlit AI pilot lamp.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Laptops float on an offset halo; sleep lights merge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Set the stack down with a hard contact shadow and separate the lights.
